references.label: A skill-shot lane
references.description: The orange top lane lights the spinner add-on and feeds the top bumper.

references.label: Right spinner
references.description: The right spinner feeds the top lanes and advances M-A-G-I-C and bonus.
references.context: Shoot the right spinner to reach the top lanes.

references.label: Left spinner
references.description: The left spinner deflects the ball toward the upper three-bank.
references.context: Shoot the left spinner to feed the drop bank.

references.label: Lightning-bolt three-bank
references.description: Completing the upper three-bank advances Bonus X and escalating bank awards.
references.context: Complete the three lightning-bolt drop targets.

references.label: Collect Bonus saucer
references.description: The hidden upper-left saucer immediately scores the current bonus.
references.context: Collect the upper-left bonus saucer when a large bonus is ready.

references.label: Center star rollover
references.description: The lower center star raises return-lane values.
references.context: Roll over the red center star before using return lanes.
